::: {#def-renyi-entropy}
#### Rényi entropy of order 2 (collision entropy)

The **Rényi entropy of order 2**, also called the **collision entropy**, of a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ is the negative [logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm) of the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of its [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability), <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
where $\P(X)$ is the [probability mass function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pmf) evaluated at the [random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) $X$ itself
[@wikipedia_renyi_entropy]:

$$H_2(X) = -\log \E{\P(X)}.$$

:::
